## Personality

Joshua Pye is a surly and taciturn individual. He is highly unsociable, preferring independence and solitude.

## History

During the ongoing hall improvement project, Joshua Pye painted the town hall a shocking bright blue due to a mix-up with the paint numbers. News of the incident quickly spread across town, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Fred](../character/fred-wright.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and Oliver in shared dismay over the disaster.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P24](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0024), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032)_
